evidence:
Walked instruction.md and hireops_rules.md line by line against the frozen solution. Every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation.
- Views: staff get Board, Conversations, Activity (app.js:87-91 buildViews); candidates get only 'My applications' (app.js:89; threads.js:27,222). Sign-in/out; all 10 seeded accounts with Hireops!2026 (index.js:84-101; db.js seedIfEmpty).
- Jobs/candidates (rules s2): recruiter-only POST /api/jobs with title, team, hiring-manager choice, places 1-50 (index.js:202-214; board.js:61-81); POST /api/applications with email check, case-insensitive duplicate refusal returning field=candidate_email, candidate-account linking, bottom of Applied (index.js:216-233); error shown at the email field with typed values kept (board.js:47-56).
- Board (rules s3): six stages from seed [APPLIED,SCREEN,INTERVIEW,OFFER,HIRED,REJECTED]; one stage at a time, reject needs reason, Hired cannot be rejected, reopen only to origin (index.js:238-256); ordinary controls = per-card select+Move and Up/Down (board.js:208-244); drag optional with drop position (board.js:242,300-319); shared persisted order (index.js:199-200,318). Interview places counted for the whole set, reorder inside allowed (index.js:290-295). HM limited to own job and Interview/Offer/Hired incl. reject/reopen rules; observer/candidate refused (index.js:257-264,326-333). Version conflict 409 naming who via the card's last activity line (index.js:241-245). Optimistic move, snapshot put-back, refresh to real place, reason shown, focus back on the card's controls (board.js:166-205). Bulk all-or-none in one immediate transaction, board order by stage then place (index.js:274-321,339-344; board.js:277-290). Undo of own latest move, single-use, restores stage/place/rejection reason, refused on any version change or Interview overfill (index.js:165-168,348-373; board.js:291-299). Card detail with internal notes, role-limited writing, unsaved note kept per user per browser (board.js:85-141; keep key includes user id app.js:39-43; index.js:386-398).
- Activity (rules s4): open/add/move/reject(with reason)/reopen/reorder/undo logged as readable lines inside the same transaction, so refused actions add none (index.js:195-198,211,230,266-271,315,366); view newest first, all jobs or one chosen job (index.js:189; app.js:45-85).
- Live (rules s5): SSE 'changed' after every successful write incl. read markers (index.js:45-54,102-107), relayed across tabs (app.js:130-164); keyed in-place patching preserves open card, typing, focus and scroll (board.js:321-341; threads.js:36-65,145-159). Scripted run measured arrival_ms 805 (< 15 s).
- Conversations (rules s6): role access matrix (index.js:114-131); newest 30 oldest-first scrolled to bottom, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count, scroll anchored (index.js:401-417; threads.js:110-131,160-175); scrolled-up arrival keeps place, shows 'N new messages', stays unread (threads.js:145-159,176-181); Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused after send, failed send keeps text with error (threads.js:183-201); line breaks kept (styles.css:105 white-space: pre-wrap); per-person unread and total badge (index.js:132-139; app.js:115-121; threads.js:221); seen receipt with observer excluded (index.js:143-150; threads.js:76-83); drafts per user per conversation in localStorage, survive switch/reload/session loss; 401 triggers re-sign-in prompt with email prefilled; other users see none (app.js:26-43,187-195; threads.js:112,124,182).
- Candidate (rules s7): own applications with job title, team, seed candidate wording, unread/last message only; no notes, reason, rejected_from, position, other candidates or activity in the payload (index.js:171-177); conversation not auto-opened (threads.js:7); staff endpoints 403/404 for candidates (index.js:326-333,378-385).
- Runtime contract: node /app/server.js on 0.0.0.0, PORT honoured, /api/health answered by the main thread before any DB work (bootstrap.js:20-26,45-47); UI+API from one process (worker thread + loopback proxy); DB_PATH honoured, default resolves to /app/app.db (db.js DB_PATH); seed copied to src/seed_data.json byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json and loaded once (seedIfEmpty guard); solve.sh copies the app and removes any existing DB; no package install.
